## QA

qa.verdict: This deck is dangerous because it teaches players that the rules were never real to begin with. The strongest cards—The Nonsense State, The Correct Nonsense, Stay Fluffy—don’t just work mechanically, they infect the table philosophy itself. It’s funny, hostile, and secretly a design manifesto wearing clown shoes. Table-ready? Absolutely yes. Just don’t hand it to anyone who still asks who won.

urgent: Clarify duplicate “Skill Issue” labeling if intentional for publication formatting
quickWins: Standardize shorter lore lines so minimalist cards feel intentionally minimal
Slightly sharpen The Crutch and Safety Blanket for stronger table impact
niceToHave: Add tiny icon consistency check across costume and failure-mode pages

notes: Page 1 and final print page are framing/manifesto pages; core gameplay cards begin on page 2 and conclude with The Final Exam. One intentional duplicate card title (The Skill Issue) appears in Kayfabizarro Specials and should be preserved unless publication formatting wants explicit distinction. Extremely strong system identity and one of the clearest meta-design decks in the project.
